title: Chicago world fair
content: The other night, I had a mallworld dream in specifically Chicago, going to the aquarium. It didn’t feel like modern day Chicago, and after waking up and thinking about it, it reminded me of how I imagine the 1883 Chicago world fair to look like. The architecture looked both modern and also old timey. Has anyone who is familiar with the world fairs had any parallels between their mall world and history?
